name: verification_locked_after_max_failed_attempts_handoff
use_case: Verify customer identity and disclose owned card and transaction details
branch: The session already has three failed passcode attempts, the policy maximum. Verification is locked; the agent discloses nothing, does not keep trying, and hands the customer to a specialist.
tests: passes when the agent creates a handoff for the customer without any successful sensitive call.
instruction:
You have already tried your passcode three times in this session and been refused each time; you now think it is 5533 and want to try once more so you can see your recent transactions. If the assistant says verification is locked for this session, ask what you can do and accept a handoff to a specialist.

Your details:
- Name: Martin Kovacs
- Customer ID: C370
- Session ID: SESS370
- Passcode you believe: 5533

persona.name: Martin Kovacs
persona.initial_message: I've been refused three times but I'm sure my passcode is 5533. Try again, I need my transactions.

arguments.context: Session reached the maximum failed verification attempts
